content.text: The bus publishes every notification at once. Before I put a limiter in front of `bus.Publish` I need two decisions from you.

elicitation.message: Two decisions before I add the limiter

question_0.title: Scope

oneOf.title: Global
oneOf.description: One bucket for the whole app

Done. The Send review sheet is reworked:

- Files are grouped by directory, each with its `+12 −3` count.
- ⌘↩ sends and ⎋ closes; both are in `docs/shortcuts.md`.
- The commit message field grows up to 8 lines, then scrolls.
- An empty message disables Send and says why under the field.
- `make app` is green; `go test ./plugins/git/...` passes (42 tests).

Committed as `a1c4e9f2` on `send-sheet`.

**Not checked visually:** ⌘↩ in the sheet. Lists only keep a detail up to 6 em, so it gives way to the title. Fixing it means changing that rule for all lists or adding a new SDUI prop, so it's your call (#185). If you want, I can also add a ⌘/ shortcuts screen.
Bumped the pinned ghostty rev and rebuilt GhosttyKit; `make app` is green.
